commander.name: Breya, Etherium Shaper
commander.oracle_text:
When Breya enters, create two 1/1 blue Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying.
{2}, Sacrifice two artifacts: Choose one —
• Breya deals 3 damage to target player or planeswalker.
• Target creature gets -4/-4 until end of turn.
• You gain 5 life.

themes.name: Thopter Swarm Foundry
themes.pitch: Flood the skies with tiny brass flyers, then swing over the top while Breya keeps making more.

themes.name: Etherium Sacrificial Engine
themes.pitch: Feed artifacts into Breya's furnace and let every crunch drain, kill, or gain something.

themes.name: Artificer's Grand Workshop
themes.pitch: Chain artifacts together, cheat costs down, and turn a pile of gadgets into overwhelming card advantage.

themes.name: Scrap Heap Treasure Trove
themes.pitch: Every Treasure, Clue, and Food is a fresh sacrifice offering, ramping you while you fuel Breya's blasts.

themes.name: Armed and Etherium-Plated
themes.pitch: Bolt gear onto Breya or a Thopter and let a shiny, well-equipped hero carry the fight.

themes.name: Twice-Forged Artificers
themes.pitch: Flicker and copy Breya and her ETB friends to spawn Thopters and value over and over.
